brief.question: The person asked for 'a website for my bakery' and added 'make an order system'. There is no original target: rebuild the established four-page warm artisan placeholder site (Home, Menu, Our Story, Visit) in Vite + React + TypeScript, and add a working order/cart/checkout flow.
brief.purpose: Deliver the requested bakery website with a usable order system as a static build under app/dist.
constraints: No original target - the earlier plain-JS build is the only design reference
Neutral placeholder brand 'Hearth & Crumb' and original line-art icons, no copied logos/photos
Static build with relative base './' ; no dev servers or watchers started by hand
Branding/style choices remain open with the person
brief.done_when: npm run build succeeds, the four original pages plus a new order page render as static files, the cart persists and checkout confirms an order, and rebuild_check results are reported with any limits.

plan.title: Study the existing pages and the evidence
plan.why: Captured all copy, icons, styles and behaviour of the four plain-JS pages.

plan.title: Rebuild the four pages in React + TypeScript
plan.why: Home, Menu, Our Story and Visit are React pages with the original look and copy.

plan.title: Add the order system
plan.why: Add-to-cart, persistent basket, quantity controls, checkout details and order confirmation, plus a new Order page.

plan.title: Install packages and make the build succeed
plan.why: npm run build passes and app/dist contains all five HTML pages.

plan.title: Check the result and fix what I can
plan.why: rebuild_check passed; a scripted browser run placed an order successfully. Only a favicon 404 remains.

plan.title: Report what is built and what is still unknown
plan.why: Branding, style and order-scope choices remain open with the person.

findings.statement: The four original pages were rebuilt in Vite + React + TypeScript and a new Order page was added. npm run build passes and app/dist contains index, menu, about, visit and order HTML plus shared CSS/JS assets, with base './' so it works as static files.

The order system works end to end in a scripted browser run: an item added on the menu appears in the basket with the correct total, checkout details can be filled in, and placing the order shows a numbered confirmation ('Order HC-…', 'Thank you, Test Customer'). Cart state persists in local storage and the basket badge updates. The check passed with no page errors.

handoff: This turn rebuilt the bakery site in Vite + React + TypeScript (replacing the earlier plain-JS build) and added a working order system. app/dist now has five static pages: index, menu, about, visit and the new order page. The basket lives in localStorage, the header badge follows it, and checkout produces a numbered confirmation with pay-at-pickup (no online payment or order delivery to the bakery — open question unk_9fa30d5afcc67a29). Brand placeholder 'Hearth & Crumb' and warm artisan style were kept because no real name/style was given (unknowns unk_753a122cc72f977f, unk_ab833bb9e2ac0722). npm run build passes; rebuild_check says 'build: passed' with no visual comparison possible because there is no original target. A scripted browser run placed an order successfully (ev_751684569ed1383122c621cca5b0bda40a7ce6d9e42ad38c01ad120f6c5930ce). The only console noise is a favicon.ico 404, harmless. Trap: an old vite.config.js shadowed the new vite.config.ts and had to be deleted; keep only the TS config. Environment: node/npm at C:\Program Files\nodejs; build via the Craft Anything build runner in app/. Next useful step: ask the person for the real bakery name/style and whether they want real payment or orders emailed to them.
